aboutText: I.L Building Services is Sunshine West's trusted cabinet maker, delivering expert custom cabinetry to homeowners and businesses across Melbourne's western suburbs for over 15 years. From kitchen renovations in Montmorency to commercial fit-outs in Glen Waverley, our skilled team designs and builds storage solutions tailored to your space. We proudly service Sunshine West, Geelong, Aberfeldie, West Melbourne, Glen Waverley, Kinnear, and surrounding areas with honest workmanship and fair pricing.
servicesText: From custom kitchens to commercial shopfits, I.L Building Services provides precision cabinet making solutions across Melbourne's west. Every piece is built to your specifications using quality materials.
